source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The extension browser test added direct checks that setQuickFilter updates the visible bar, active filter buttons, and text while exercising show, clear, and flagged state. Its companion quickFilterBar.js change emits qfbtoggle only when the hidden state actually changes. The first Try run found that the test belonged in the existing browser_ext_quickFilter.js file, then the accepted patch moved it there.
title: Assert both extension filter results and visible filter controls
